query:
SELECT 
  c.name as ceo_name,
  ct.id as tube_id, ct.identifier as tube_name, ct.type as tube_type,
  cv.id as via_id, cv.viaNumber, cv.label,
  cv.fusedToTubeId, cv.fusedToViaId,
  cv.fusedToSplitterId, cv.fusedToSplitterViaId
FROM ceos c
JOIN ceo_tubes ct ON ct.ceoId = c.id
JOIN ceo_vias cv ON cv.tubeId = ct.id
ORDER BY c.id, ct.id, cv.viaNumber;
